categories.main_business_segments: Hwatsing Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, sales, and technical services of high-end semiconductor equipment, including CMP (Chemical Mechanical Polishing) equipment, thinning equipment, dicing equipment, edge polishing equipment, ion implantation equipment, wet process equipment, wafer regeneration, and key consumables and maintenance services. The company has implemented an 'equipment + services' platform strategy and serves integrated circuit manufacturing, advanced packaging, large silicon wafers, third-generation semiconductors, MEMS, and MicroLED sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on core proprietary technologies such as nano-level polishing, nano-particle ultra-clean cleaning, nano-precision film thickness online detection, big data analysis and intelligent control, and ultra-precision thinning. It develops advanced CMP systems with multi-zone pressure control, adaptive polishing heads, and intelligent polishing technologies. Production methods include modular design, order-based and inventory production, and integration of advanced polishing, thinning, dicing, and cleaning processes. The company also emphasizes domestic localization of key components to ensure supply chain security.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Hwatsing serves leading integrated circuit manufacturers and research institutes, including major domestic clients such as SMIC, Yangtze Memory Technologies, Huahong Group, and Changxin Memory Technologies. Its products are widely applied in logic chips, memory chips, advanced packaging, large silicon wafers, third-generation semiconductors, MEMS, and MicroLED manufacturing processes. The company’s customer base is concentrated in the semiconductor manufacturing industry.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations and sales are primarily concentrated in Mainland China, with significant activities in Tianjin (headquarters), Beijing, Shanghai, and Guangzhou. It also has subsidiaries and investments in Shanghai and other key Chinese semiconductor hubs. The company’s market focus is domestic, with growing influence in the Chinese semiconductor equipment sector.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hwatsing operates in the upstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain as a high-end semiconductor equipment manufacturer and technology service provider. It supplies critical manufacturing equipment and consumables to integrated circuit fabs and related semiconductor manufacturing entities, supporting wafer fabrication and advanced packaging processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation and R&D investment, focusing on advancing CMP equipment, thinning, dicing, edge polishing, ion implantation, and wet process technologies. It actively develops new products aligned with emerging semiconductor trends such as 2.5D/3D IC packaging and third-generation semiconductors. Hwatsing also emphasizes building a robust intellectual property portfolio, talent development, and expanding production capacity through new facilities and acquisitions, including the acquisition of a controlling stake in an ion implantation equipment company.
categories.revenue_model: Hwatsing generates revenue primarily through direct sales of semiconductor manufacturing equipment and related consumables. It also earns income from providing technical services, maintenance, upgrades, and wafer regeneration services. The company employs a direct sales model with contracts signed directly with customers and offers after-sales support and consumable supplies as recurring revenue streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hwatsing holds a leading domestic position in the CMP equipment market, competing against international giants like Applied Materials and Ebara, which historically dominated the global market. In thinning and dicing equipment, the company is emerging but faces competition from established foreign suppliers such as Japan's DISCO. Hwatsing is recognized as a domestic champion with growing market share and technological capabilities, aiming to reduce reliance on imports and enhance supply chain security.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Hwatsing achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.4 billion, representing a 35.82% year-over-year increase, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 1.02 billion, up 41.40%. The company has shown strong growth in sales volume and market share, with significant increases in R&D investment (nearly RMB 394 million, up 29.56%). Total assets and net assets have grown substantially, supported by expanded production capacity and acquisitions. The company maintains a healthy cash flow and continues to invest in strategic projects.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hwatsing emphasizes its core proprietary technologies, high product performance, and quality, combined with comprehensive after-sales service and localized support. Its CMP equipment and other semiconductor manufacturing tools are tailored to meet advanced process requirements, including nano-level precision and multi-zone pressure control. The company’s focus on domestic supply chain localization, integration of equipment and services, and alignment with emerging semiconductor trends such as advanced packaging and third-generation semiconductors differentiate it from competitors and provide customers with reliable, innovative, and cost-effective solutions.
